objective: Revisar somente o peso de repeated_synchronization para 2.0, preservando respostas antigas tecnicamente compatíveis.
subject: Empresas avaliadas pelo perfil digital_twin existente.
target_definition: Measures how strongly the supplied evidence supports the functional characteristics of a digital twin.
decision_use: Mesmo construto e uso do baseline; mudança solicitada de importância relativa da sincronização.
evidence_description: Mesmo contrato de evidência e instrução do baseline; sem nova coleta.
evidence_exclusions: Critérios e instrução alterados por reescrita
Inferência de validade empírica pela mudança de peso

required_dimensions.name: specific_counterpart
required_dimensions.definition: Does the evidence clearly show a digital representation of one specific, identifiable physical or biological counterpart, rather than a generic model?

required_dimensions.name: individualized_data_link
required_dimensions.definition: Does measured data from that specific counterpart initialize or personalize its corresponding model?

required_dimensions.name: repeated_synchronization
required_dimensions.definition: Is the virtual representation repeatedly updated with new data from the same real-world counterpart?

required_dimensions.name: simulation_prediction
required_dimensions.definition: Does the virtual representation simulate scenarios, predict outcomes, or evaluate interventions?

optional_signals.name: self_claim
optional_signals.definition: Does the company explicitly call this product or technology a digital twin?

optional_signals.name: enabling_technology
optional_signals.definition: Even if a complete digital twin is not evidenced, is this clearly an enabling component such as virtual modeling, simulation, sensing, or data integration?

missing_evidence_policy: Preservada literalmente na instrução do perfil; não introduzir novo comportamento.
compensation_policy: Preservar weighted_geometric_bottleneck com 0.6 geométrico e 0.4 mínimo; peso 2.0 apenas em repeated_synchronization.
known_edge_cases: Sincronização fraca com demais dimensões altas
